lines.en: My steps are heavy; the floor complains.
I drag my body down the corridor.
The plate in my chest rattles.

lines.zh: 我的下颌松了，走路一开一合
lines.en: My jaw hangs loose and works as I walk.
I walk slowly, but I never stop.

lines.zh: 每一块地砖都被我踩响
lines.en: Every tile rings under me.
I walk with my head tilted, seeing poorly.

lines.zh: 走廊尽头有灯，我朝那儿走
lines.en: There is a light at the corridor's end; I head for it.
My steps echo between walls.

lines.zh: 我一步一步把距离吃掉
lines.en: Step by step I eat the distance.

lines.zh: 我张开的嘴一直没合上
lines.en: My open mouth has never closed.

lines.zh: 我把墙上的海报蹭歪了
lines.en: I knock a poster crooked on the wall.

lines.zh: 我站在走廊中间，头歪着
lines.en: I stand in the corridor, head tilted.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛亮着两点白光
lines.en: Two white points glow in my eyes.

lines.zh: 我胸口挂着的盘子空着
lines.en: The plate on my chest hangs empty.
My fingers twitch.
I do not breathe, yet my chest moves.
A drop falls from my jaw.
I listen to sounds behind doors.

lines.zh: 我站在墙角，影子替我动。
lines.en: I stand in the corner; my shadow moves for me.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，盯住走廊尽头。
lines.en: I tilt my head and stare down the hall.
The ceiling tube flickers.

lines.zh: 我的影子在地上晃了一下
lines.en: My shadow sways on the floor.

lines.zh: 我抬起手摸了摸自己的下颌
lines.en: I raise a hand and touch my own jaw.

lines.zh: 通风口里有风，吹动我的布
lines.en: Air from the vent stirs my cloth.
I hear someone running far off.

lines.zh: 我慢慢换脚，地板吱呀一声。
lines.en: I shift my feet; the floor creaks.

lines.zh: 我的手指在空气里抓了一下
lines.en: My fingers close on empty air.
Slowly I turn my head straight.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛对着你，没有眨
lines.en: My eyes are on you, unblinking.
You have warmth; I do not.

lines.zh: 我的嘴张开了，比刚才大
lines.en: My mouth opens wider than before.

lines.zh: 你退到墙边，墙是我熟的地方
lines.en: You back to the wall; I know walls.
I shift one step forward.

lines.zh: 我的喉咙里发出一点点声音
lines.en: A little sound comes from my throat.
You are counting my teeth.
I look at you askew, my neck clicking.

lines.zh: 你不该在这个时间还在走廊
lines.en: You should not be in this corridor at this hour.

lines.zh: 我把脸凑近，近得不像话
lines.en: I bring my face close, far too close.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛在看门，不是看我
lines.en: Your eyes are on the door, not on me.
I raise a hand and point behind you.
The tile by your foot is ringing.

lines.zh: 我的下颌在你耳边张合
lines.en: My jaw works beside your ear.

lines.zh: 我一步一步把你逼向角落
lines.en: Step by step I press you to the corner.
You are fumbling in your pocket.
I am not afraid of your weapon.

lines.zh: 我的关节响了一声，歪了
lines.en: A joint pops and goes crooked.
My chest has caved a little.
My plastic shell splits, showing hollow space.
My jaw snaps shut once.
My eyes dim for a breath.

lines.zh: 我的手垂下来，抬不太起
lines.en: My hand drops and barely rises.

lines.zh: 我的外壳上多了一道口子
lines.en: A gash has opened in my shell.
I still move, only slower.
Half my jaw has come off.
I step back and lean on the wall.
I do not eat, but I will take it.
Put what you hold on the table.

lines.zh: 我胸口那个盘子一直空着
lines.en: The plate on my chest stays empty.
I reach out, slowly.
It will break in my hand.
Step back; I only want that.

lines.zh: 我闻不到，可我知道你在藏
lines.en: I cannot smell, but I know you are hiding something.

lines.zh: 你的手在抖，东西快掉了
lines.en: Your hand shakes; it will drop.
I wait with my mouth open, and have waited long.
The plate is empty and it bothers me.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，我的盘子响了
lines.en: We collide and my plate rings.

lines.zh: 你撞在我的胸口，被弹开
lines.en: You hit my chest and bounce off.
I barely give a single step.
My jaw knocks your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我抬手把你扶了一下，然后又推
lines.en: I catch you, then push.
Two bodies meet with a dull sound.

lines.zh: 你被我的体重压退了两步
lines.en: My weight pushes you back two steps.
My hand catches your clothes.
The lights sway when we collide.
My knee meets your leg.
There is another one in this corridor.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，谁都不说
lines.en: We stand side by side, silent.
Her jaw hangs loose too.

lines.zh: 我们的眼睛朝同一个方向
lines.en: Our eyes face the same way.
We guard this door, together.
She is no faster, but louder.
Her plate is empty too.

lines.zh: 我们把影子叠在走廊里
lines.en: Our shadows stack in the corridor.
We turn forward together.

lines.zh: 她的手指和我的扣在一起
lines.en: Her fingers lock with mine.
I crouch and my joints crack in a chain.

lines.zh: 我拾起地上的一件东西
lines.en: I pick up something off the floor.

lines.zh: 我拿着它，指头不知道松
lines.en: I hold it, and my fingers will not release.

lines.zh: 我把它放进胸口的盘里
lines.en: I drop it onto the plate on my chest.

lines.zh: 我又捡起一件，慢慢站直
lines.en: I pick up another and straighten slowly.

lines.zh: 我捡东西的时候几乎没有声音
lines.en: I make almost no sound picking it up.

lines.zh: 我弯腰的时候肚子响了一下
lines.en: My belly creaks as I bend.
I close it in my palm.
I pick up a shard of broken porcelain.

lines.zh: 我把它举到眼前看了看
lines.en: I hold it up before my eyes.

lines.zh: 我停下，头完全转过来了
lines.en: I stop, my head fully turned.
My mouth opens as far as it goes.

lines.zh: 你动了，我就知道你在哪
lines.en: You moved; now I know where you are.

lines.zh: 我向你走过去，一步比一步快
lines.en: I come for you, faster each step.
My eyes burn whiter.
I do not scream, and need not.
My head has turned all the way.

lines.zh: 我的喙在灯下反了一下光。
lines.en: My beak flashes once under the light.

lines.zh: 你在我正前方，没有遮挡
lines.en: You are dead ahead, with no cover.
I raise both hands, palms toward you.

lines.zh: 我不急，走廊没有别的出口
lines.en: I am in no hurry; the corridor has one exit.

lines.zh: 我一步一步缩短这段距离
lines.en: I shorten the distance step by step.

lines.zh: 你的手放在门把上，别动
lines.en: Your hand is on the handle; leave it.
I close my jaw.
What you hear is me walking.

lines.zh: 我不需要跑就能抓到你
lines.en: I need not run to catch you.
The corridor is long, and I have no end.
You turn the corner; so do I.

lines.zh: 我的脚步压着你的节奏
lines.en: My steps press on your rhythm.
I hear your breathing clearly.
I do not run, but I never stop.
The corridor is long, and I have no end.
I hug the wall, taking little space.

lines.zh: 你关上灯，我照样看得见
lines.en: Turn off the lights; I still see.

lines.zh: 地板响一下，我就近一尺。
lines.en: Each creak of the floor brings me a foot closer.

lines.zh: 你每退一步，走廊就短一截
lines.en: Each step back shortens the corridor.
I raise a hand and touch the wall.

lines.zh: 你藏在门后，呼吸太响了。
lines.en: You hide behind the door; your breathing is loud.
I round the corner without stopping.

lines.zh: 你躲到桌子后面，桌子太矮
lines.en: You hide behind a table; it is too low.
I knock a chair out of the way.
My shadow already covers the door.

lines.zh: 你站在通风口下，没用的
lines.en: You stand under the vent; it will not help.
I wait for you at the corridor's end.
I swing a hand across.
My jaw comes down.
I use my body's weight on you.

lines.zh: 我的指头刮过你的手臂
lines.en: My fingers rake your arm.
You block once and fly back far.
One blow from me is already heavy.
I swing a second time.
My nails rake the door frame.
I drop my head and ram you.
My palm slaps the wall.

lines.zh: 我的手掌把你钉在门框。
lines.en: My palm pins you to the doorframe.
I kick your leg aside.

lines.zh: 我的下颌咬住了你的袖
lines.en: My jaw clamps on your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我的第二下比第一下重
lines.en: My second blow is heavier than the first.
You fall back down the corridor; I follow.
I raise a hand, then lower it slowly.
The door at the corridor's end opens.
My shadow comes first.

lines.zh: 我走进去，地板响了一声
lines.en: I step in and the floor sounds.
My eyes glow in the dark.
The teeth in my mouth grew too long.
I settle in the doorway, very quiet.
I walk out of the dark into the light.
My shadow enters the door before me.

lines.zh: 地板在我脚下响成一片
lines.en: The floor rings beneath me.

lines.zh: 我停在走廊的第一块砖上
lines.en: I stop on the corridor's first tile.

lines.zh: 我胸口那只盘子撞出响声。
lines.en: The plate on my chest clatters.

lines.zh: 走廊的灯灭了一盏，我站这儿。
lines.en: One hallway light dies, and here I stand.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，摸了一下门框
lines.en: I raise a hand and touch the door frame.

lines.zh: 走廊里安静得能听见我
lines.en: The corridor is quiet enough to hear me.

lines.zh: 我一步一步走进这条长走廊
lines.en: I walk step by step into the long corridor.

lines.zh: 我低头，才进得去这道门
lines.en: I duck to fit through this door.
I pause half a second in the doorway.

lines.zh: 我来的路上没有关一盏灯
lines.en: I left not one lamp on my way here.

lines.zh: 火烧到我的外壳，里面露出金属
lines.en: Fire takes my shell, and metal shows beneath.

lines.zh: 我从台阶上摔下，砸在平台上
lines.en: I fall down the steps and hit the landing.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的胸腔，我发出怪声
lines.en: Water floods my chest and I make an odd sound.
The blast throws my jaw wide.
An arrow lodges in my shell.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的关节都僵了一下
lines.en: That force locks all my joints for a moment.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可这副身体在空转
lines.en: I do not eat, yet this body idles hollow.

lines.zh: 雷穿过我的外壳，灯全灭了
lines.en: Lightning passes through my shell and every light dies.

lines.zh: 脚下的地板没了，我一直往下
lines.en: The floor is gone; I keep falling.
